_what:
toprow_corner_coverage.py — WHICH MEMBERS' ROWS FEED THE CANONICAL'S BOTTOM CORNER
BOXES, and what a row-level exclusion would leave there. RECORDS-ONLY: header + record
reads (astropy WCS, both sides SIP), no pixel opened, no product, no build-path file.
Record: toprow_corner_coverage.json beside this file (ledger id toprow_corner_coverage).

METHOD. For each of the 77 members a 100-px sample grid over the member's KEPT extent
(a cropped copy keeps round(W/2 + x_c) columns) is projected member WCS -> sky -> the
canonical _wcs.fit -> canvas; a canvas box is the 800-px square centred on its sky
position (the four bottom corner boxes from cropT_arm.json's rows; the 22 rowmin probe
boxes rebuilt at the six rowmin members' +1200/+1800/+2400 station centres on their
top / bottom rows, exactly as that arm placed them). A member COVERS a box when any of
its sample points lands inside; its LANDING BAND is the median member y of those points.
Y CONVENTION (the trap docs/dead-ends/verification-traps.md records): astropy works in
FITS pixel rows (y up), Siril's crop boxes count y DOWN — the profiled "top row" (Siril
y 0..800) is FITS y >= H - 800, and that is what "top strip" means everywhere here.

ESTIMATOR (with its positive control): the box's FWHM ~ the STACKCNT-weighted mean over
the covering members of the member's own profiled top-30 FWHM at the station nearest the
landing point — the top-row profile (toprow_profiles.json) for a top-strip landing, the
cache's centre-row profile for a centre-band landing, the nearer of the two otherwise
(flagged). CONTROL: on the CURRENT set it must reproduce the canonical's measured corner
values within 0.10 px, or the U5 prediction it yields is not usable.

U5: the 29 members over S_top p25 + 0.20 lose their top 800 rows -> coverage and the
estimate recomputed from what remains. DILUTION (rowmin): at each probe the six rowmin
members' REMOVED-column share of the weighted coverage.

estimator_control.criterion: |estimate_now - measured| <= 0.10 px at the four bottom corner boxes

compose_gate_record.carries: per-member dims (member_dims), per-member detected star counts (detected), per-member optics stamps (optics), and PAIRWISE cross-match separations by member-own radius zone (pairs, 2926 pairs; worst; unmeasured_pairs) — the member-separation instrument's output
compose_gate_record.cannot_answer: it holds NO per-member canvas placement, homography or coverage: the separations are computed in the reference member's frame through register -2pass homographies that are not stored in the record (instrument text), so which members cover which canvas box is not derivable from it — the WCS pin above is the only source for that; the record can say which member PAIRS disagree most where they overlap (its 'worst' pair s_00052|s_00069 at 11.4 px in the mid zone), not where on the canvas

verdict.convention_fix_and_cross_check: the first run classified rows in FITS y (up) while the profiled 'top row' is Siril y-down 0..800 = FITS y >= H-800 — the y-convention trap (docs/dead-ends/verification-traps.md) fired again and was caught by the band counts (every coverer 'other'); fixed, then CROSS-CHECKED: the corrected projection reproduces rowmin Part A's pinned canvas positions for all eight members to the pixel (diff [0, 0] on every one: {"aug14/set-04/sub_01": [1799, 4249], "aug14/set-04/sub_04": [1106, 4142], "aug14/set-05/sub_01": [2169, 4404], "aug14/set-05/sub_02": [1840, 4356], "aug09/set-05/sub_01": [1509, 4008], "aug09/set-05/sub_02": [1222, 3962], "july31/set-01/sub_01": [2205, 4886], "aug06/set-01/sub_01": [3172, 4455]})

estimator_control.criterion: |estimate_now - measured| <= 0.10 px at the four bottom corner boxes
estimator_control.verdict: FAILED at 4/4 (-0.11..-0.20): the STACKCNT-weighted mean of the covering members' own local top-30 FWHM UNDER-reads the canonical's corner boxes by 0.11-0.20 px, and over all 26 boxes by mean -0.176 (median -0.175, range -0.228..-0.113) — a systematic negative bias, not scatter. Mechanism candidates, not separated here: the compose's own resample pass (~6 % of PSF width, resample-cost-and-drizzle), the edge of the member beyond its +2400 station (the corner landings sit at member x 5350-5750, past the station centre), and a canvas box's top-30 drawing from a union of member positions. CONSEQUENCE: the estimator is NOT usable for an absolute corner prediction; its after-minus-now differences are reported as RELATIVE readings under the untested premise of a uniform bias

verdict.reading: the canonical's BOTTOM-LEFT corner boxes are covered by 16 (corner_700_4200) and 17 (corner_1300_4900) members — mostly july31 (9 and 12), the sharpest night — landing with their TOP rows' ENTRY side (13/16 and 17/17 in the top strip or just below it, station along+2400/+1800 — the flip rowmin pinned). The 29 over-bar members are a MINORITY there (3 and 1 coverers) — a row-level exclusion changes the coverage count only 16 -> 13 and 17 -> 16 — but the ones it removes are the SOFTEST coverers at corner_700_4200 (aug09/set-05/sub_04 3.08, aug09/set-05/sub_01 2.79, aug09/set-03/sub_05 2.70 against the rest 2.45-2.68), so the relative estimate moves -0.066 there and -0.049 at corner_1300_4900. The BOTTOM-RIGHT boxes are the opposite case: 37 and 38 coverers, dominated by aug09 + aug14 (16+20 / 10+13); the exclusion removes 17 of 37 coverers at corner_7000_4900 (aug14 20 -> 8, aug09 16 -> 11 — a -46 %% member-depth cost) for a relative -0.016, and 5 of 38 at corner_7500_4400 for -0.002

U5_prediction_as_numbers.what_can_be_predicted: coverage counts (geometry, measured): corner_700_4200 16 -> 13 (july31 9, aug09 7 -> 4), corner_1300_4900 17 -> 16 (aug14 3 -> 2), corner_7000_4900 37 -> 20 (aug09 16 -> 11, aug14 20 -> 8), corner_7500_4400 38 -> 33; the 22 probe boxes: the top-row probes lose 4-20 coverers (aug14 25 -> 5..18), the bottom-row probes none
U5_prediction_as_numbers.what_cannot: an absolute corner FWHM — the estimator failed its control; the RELATIVE readings (uniform-bias premise) are corner_700_4200 -0.066, corner_1300_4900 -0.049, corner_7000_4900 -0.016, corner_7500_4400 -0.002, the top-row probes -0.03..-0.15
U5_prediction_as_numbers.honest_pre_registration_for_U5: P1: corner_700_4200 and corner_1300_4900 read LOWER by >= 0.05 px (measured floor 0.000, repeat_floor_corpus_compose); P2: corner_7000_4900 within +0.05 (a 46 %% member-depth loss there must not degrade it — a DEGRADATION row if it does); P3: every other station within +-0.02; P4: pixel-frames removed reported (the 29 members' top 800 rows = 29 x 800 x W of ~ 5.8 M px each ~ 4 %% of the pixel-frames); P5: the rim staircase at the bottom edge changes — reported as the accepted coverage cost; the compose gate record cannot supply any of this (below)

rowmin_dilution_counted.summary: at every one of the 22 probe boxes the six rowmin members' REMOVED columns were 3.0-5.6 % of the STACKCNT-weighted coverage (median 4.2 %), under 47-77 coverers — the dilution hypothesis is CONFIRMED as arithmetic: a 3-6 % share of the mean cannot move it by 0.1 px unless the removed part is > 2 px softer, and the arm measured -0.004..-0.033

verdict.compose_gate_record: it holds NO per-member canvas placement, homography or coverage: the separations are computed in the reference member's frame through register -2pass homographies that are not stored in the record (instrument text), so which members cover which canvas box is not derivable from it — the WCS pin above is the only source for that; the record can say which member PAIRS disagree most where they overlap (its 'worst' pair s_00052|s_00069 at 11.4 px in the mid zone), not where on the canvas
premises_not_tested: the estimator's bias is uniform across boxes (its control FAILED; the relative U5 readings rest on this)
the 100-px grid resolves coverage at the box edge to +-50 px
coverage counts members, not pixel-frames: a member covering a box with a sliver counts as one coverer (n_points recorded per member in the record)
the top-30 in a canvas box samples the union at slightly different sky positions than any member's station box
